name: wytchr
title: Wytchr
description: Add YouTube channels to your self-hosted wytchr instance.
author: kjaymiller

commands.name: review-queue
commands.title: Review Queue
commands.subtitle: Wytchr
commands.description: Browse the latest videos in your wytchr queue, refreshing from YouTube if stale.

commands.name: open-wytchr
commands.title: Open Wytchr
commands.subtitle: Wytchr
commands.description: Open your wytchr instance in the browser.

commands.name: add-channel
commands.title: Add Channel
commands.subtitle: Wytchr
commands.description: Add a YouTube channel to wytchr with an optional name, profile, and favorites flag.

commands.name: add-active-tab
commands.title: Add Active Tab Channel
commands.subtitle: Wytchr
commands.description: Add the channel from the active browser tab to wytchr.

commands.name: add-clipboard
commands.title: Add Channel from Clipboard
commands.subtitle: Wytchr
commands.description: Read a channel URL from the clipboard and add it to wytchr.

preferences.name: baseUrl
preferences.title: Instance URL
preferences.description: Base URL of your self-hosted wytchr instance.

preferences.name: apiToken
preferences.title: API Token
preferences.description: Sent as an Authorization: Bearer token. Matches wytchr's API_TOKEN env var.

preferences.name: defaultProfile
preferences.title: Default Profile
preferences.description: Profile/preset label applied when none is specified.

preferences.name: refreshIntervalMinutes
preferences.title: Refresh Interval (Minutes)
preferences.description: Review Queue triggers a background poll if wytchr hasn't refreshed within this many minutes.
